name: Feed
description: On a successful Fangs attack against a living creature, you can mark a Stress to Feed. Place a number of tokens on this card equal to the number of Hit Points your target marks. You can hold up to 5 tokens at a time. Spend a token before an action roll to make your Fear Die a d20 instead. When you take a Long Rest, remove a token. If there are no tokens on this card, all your action and reaction rolls are made with disadvantage.
